analysis.note: Adopted reading: Vaticanus-based LXX (Swete); other reading(s): Sixtine / Ecclesiastical LXX.

Policy decision, not independent evidence: Swete (a diplomatic print of Codex Vaticanus) against the Sixtine/Brenton text, itself printed from Vaticanus. Close to a coin flip; the heavier edition is followed.
